glosses: nicht zu ändern, sich nicht ändern lassend

translations.source_sense_description: nicht zu ändern, sich nicht ändern lassend

glosses: Not changeable; incapable of being changed or of changing; immutable.

examples.text: Less than 15 minutes in, he noted that he had signed an executive order declaring that the federal government will only recognize two unchangeable sexes, male and female, and another order banning trans women from participating in women’s sports.

glosses: adj. adv. 不容改变的，不能更改的，不能收回的，不能挽回的，不可撤销的
